• **Dabang Delhi pulled off a coup on Friday as it beat Patna Pirates 37-36 to clinch its maiden Pro Kabaddi League (PKL) title.**
 
• **Delhi **was narrowly beaten by** Bengal Warriors** in last season's final, but coach **Krishan Hooda’s men dazzled** on the second time of asking.
 
• **Naveen Kumar **and **Vijay's raiding brilliance** came to the side's aid once more as the duo bagged Super **10s and scored a total of 27 points - 73 per cent of their team’s total points.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PKL stands for Pro Kabaddi League, which is a professional league for the sport of Kabaddi in India.**
 
• The league was founded in** 2014, **and since then, it has grown rapidly in popularity, making it one of the most-watched sports leagues in India.
 
• The Pro Kabaddi League consists of teams representing various cities in India, and the league follows a franchise model similar to other professional sports leagues.
 
• The league features both **men's and women's teams, and the teams compete in a round-robin format followed by playoffs.**
 
• The Pro Kabaddi League has been instrumental in the **growth of Kabaddi as a sport in India.**
 
• The league has helped to** popularize the sport beyond its traditional strongholds and has attracted a new generation of fans to the sport.**
 
• The league has also helped to create opportunities for professional Kabaddi players in India and has provided a platform for them to showcase their skills.
 
• The Pro Kabaddi League has also been a major commercial success, with major corporate sponsors and advertisers supporting the league.
 
• The league has also attracted investment from prominent Indian and international investors, including Bollywood actor Abhishek Bachchan and Ratan Tata, the former chairman of Tata Sons.
 
• The Pro Kabaddi League has also been recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and sustainability.
